name: atec System Info
author: docjojo

sections.description:
This plugin provides detailed system information, such as operating system, server, memory, PHP and database details. It will also show PHPinfo, php.ini and PHP extensions.

Third-Party Services

Once, when activating the plugin, an integrity check is requested from our server (https://atecplugins.com/) – if you give your permission.
Also, Once, when activating the plugin, an integrity check is requested from our server – if you give your permission.
Source: https://atecplugins.com/
Privacy policy: https://atecplugins.com/privacy-policy/

This plugin requests the server geo location (country, city) by sending the server IPinfo, a IP2GEO location service at to https://ipinfo.io/.
Privacy policy: https://ipinfo.io/privacy-policy
Terms: https://ipinfo.io/terms-of-service
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin to /wp-content/plugins/ or install via the WP admin panel.
  2. Activate the plugin from the Plugins menu.
  3. Select “atec System Info” link in admin menu bar.
